summary: Iteration 2 backend re-test after main agent added (a) Emergent OAuth session exchange POST /api/auth/session, (b) POST /api/auth/logout, (c) dual-token get_current_user (session_token OR JWT), (d) wrapped LLM & Stripe exceptions as 503. Result: 36/37 passed, 1 skipped (Stripe session retrieval — env-blocked by placeholder key, not a code bug). All new endpoints behave per spec: /api/auth/session returns 401 'Invalid or expired session_id' for fake IDs, 422 for missing field, 422 for empty string; /api/auth/logout returns 200 {ok:true} both with JWT and without token (idempotent). /api/auth/me with bogus Bearer now returns 401 (regression check for dual-token lookup). All JWT regression paths (register/login/me/lockout/onboarding/natal-chart/tarot/friends/compat) still 200. LLM endpoints all returned 200 this run (no budget exhaustion). Stripe checkout correctly wraps auth error as 503 without leaking the API key value.

minor.issue: Returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=1) rather than 400 with the custom 'Missing session_id' message. This is acceptable per spec (400 OR 401 OR 422 allowed), and 422 is even more informative. Cosmetic — the server-side `if not sid: raise HTTPException(400,...)` branch on line 281-282 is now dead code because Field(min_length=1) intercepts first. Consider dropping the redundant check.

Still returns 500 raw (via HTTPException(500)) when STRIPE_API_KEY is empty, and returns raw stripe SDK error text on bad session_id. Since the checkout endpoint was upgraded to 503, mirror that here for consistency.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) In server.py google_session_exchange, remove the now-dead `if not sid: raise HTTPException(400,...)` branch — Pydantic Field(min_length=1) intercepts empty strings with 422 before the handler runs.
(Optional) Mirror the Stripe 503 wrapping in GET /api/stripe/session/{session_id} — it still raises HTTPException(500) when key missing and returns raw stripe SDK exception text on retrieval failure.

Still pending from iteration_1: replace STRIPE_API_KEY placeholder 'sk_test_emergent' with a real sk_test_* key so /api/stripe/checkout can return 200 with a real Session (currently correctly returns 503 without leaking key).
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user() dual-token pattern (session_token lookup then jwt.decode) is clean and handles the bogus-token case correctly with jwt.InvalidTokenError → 401.
Session TTL: sessions_col has expireAfterSeconds=0 on expires_at index so Mongo will auto-purge expired session docs — good.
google_session_exchange upsert-by-email logic is correct and idempotent; suffix loop for username collision is fine but bounded by O(n) DB lookups. Acceptable at current scale.
logout endpoint is intentionally idempotent (no-op for JWT, deletes session_token row for Google) — matches the spec note in the review request.

server.py grew to ~770 lines with the new endpoints — now over the 700 LOC guideline. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/tarot.py, routers/friends.py, routers/stripe.py in the next iteration.
The httpx call to EMERGENT_SESSION_DATA_URL uses timeout=10s and wraps httpx.HTTPError → 503. Good defensive coding.
test_echo_api.py itself now has one unused import (`time`) inherited from iteration_1 — cosmetic.
